prompts.text: # Build: Catalog plugin (Plan Studio) Build a **plugin** (not a framework lib) named `catalog`, surfaced in Plan Studio. Brett wants it live ASAP. ## Scope 1. **Inventory** everything in the repo: framework libs (`framework/libs/*`), engines (`framework/core/engines`), React components, plugins, apps, and assets. Extend or replace Plan Studio's existing Catalog view, which today covers only plugins, apps and libs. 2. **Dependency map**: parse each item's imports/manifest and show what uses what as an interactive graph, plus a list view. Clearly **flag plugin-to-plugin dependencies** as candid…
